settings.vipPageUrlHint: Where the “Become VIP” buttons lead: a site address (e.g. /vip) or an https link.
settings.newDaysHint: How many days the label shows on recently added items (0 = never).
settings.allowCustomLabelHint: VIP members can write their own text instead of the plan name.
settings.allowYoutubeHint: The profile shows a player that only loads on click (no autoplay).
settings.allowSongUploadHint: VIP members can upload an MP3 or Ogg for their profile. GCS checks the file type and the plugin quota.

permissions.use: Can open the VIP Studio (saving needs a VIP plan)
permissions.test_all: Can test the whole catalogue without a VIP plan

widget.title: VIP online
widget.description: A carousel of VIP members: online first, with their name, frame and banner.

studio.title: VIP Studio
studio.lede: Choose how others see you: your name, frame, banner and profile. The preview changes instantly and “Save” applies everything.
studio.planNone: You don't have a VIP plan
studio.tryNotice: You can try anything in the preview. Saving needs a VIP plan.
studio.testNotice: You're testing as staff: what you save shows on the site, even without a VIP plan.
studio.saved: Your loadout was saved and is live on the site.
studio.resetDone: Your loadout was removed; the defaults show everywhere.

hints.name: How your name appears across the site. Styles with several colours open the colour strip.
hints.frame: The frame sits on top of your avatar in posts, on the card and on your profile.
hints.banner: The pill under your name, with your plan's name.
hints.card: The background of your card (hover card and post author box). Drag the image in the preview to position it.
hints.weapon: A small icon next to your stats.
hints.background: The image or video behind your profile page. Videos are muted and stop for people who prefer less motion.
hints.quote: A short quote shown on your profile in its own box. Empty = no quote.
hints.theme: The colours of your profile page (accent and panels).
hints.song: A song on your profile with a play button. It never starts on its own with sound.

card.dragHint: Or drag the image right in the preview.

quote.label: Your quote
quote.placeholder: E.g. “I play for the team, not the score.”

song.title: Displayed title
song.youtubeHint: A youtube.com or youtu.be link. On your profile the player only loads on click.
song.file: Or an MP3 / Ogg file (up to {max} MB)
song.autoplayHint: Visitors can turn the sound on anytime. Off for people who prefer less motion.

preview.label: Preview
preview.miniCaption: How you look in the header, on your card and in posts
preview.youtube: YouTube video: it only loads when you press Play.
preview.noAutoplay: On your profile, sound only starts on click.

vip.title: Become VIP to save
vip.body: Everything you tried here becomes yours with a VIP plan. Your picks stay in the preview while you're on the page.

saving.title: Equipping…
saving.body: Saving your picks and applying them across the site.

save.unavailable: {group}: this item is no longer available.

errors.guest: Sign in to use the studio.
errors.vip_required: Saving needs a VIP plan. You can try anything in the preview.
errors.locked: Some picks aren't included in your plan. Choose others or move to a higher plan.
errors.youtube_invalid: The YouTube link isn't valid. Use a youtube.com or youtu.be link.
errors.song_too_large: The audio file is too large.
errors.upload_unsupported_type: This file type isn't accepted here.
errors.upload_duration_unknown: Couldn't read the video's duration. Use a regular MP4 or WebM.
errors.upload_quota_exceeded: The studio's file space is full. Delete old items or raise the quota.
errors.upload_rate_limited: Too many uploads in an hour. Try again later.
errors.upload_too_many_files: Too many files in one form.
errors.name_required: The name is required (up to 40 characters).
errors.frame_ratio: The frame must be close to square (ratio between 4:5 and 5:4).
errors.frame_small: The frame must be at least 128 px on each side.

roster.label: VIP members
roster.empty: No VIP members yet. You could be the first.

benefits.title: VIP benefits
benefits.lede: What you can customise with a VIP plan. The list comes from the community's active catalogue.

name.title: {count} name styles
name.body: Colours, gradients and animations; {variants} styles have colour variants.

frame.title: {count} avatar frames
frame.body: On top of your avatar, in posts, on the card and on your profile.

banner.title: {count} banners
banner.body: The pill under your name, with your plan's name.
banner.bodyCustom: The pill under your name, with your plan's name or your own text.

card.title: {count} card backgrounds
card.body: On your hover card and your post author box, positioned the way you like.

weapon.title: Favourite weapon ({count})
weapon.body: An icon next to your stats.

background.title: {count} profile backgrounds
background.body: Images and videos behind your profile page.

quote.title: Personal quote
quote.body: A quote on your profile in its own box.

theme.title: {count} profile themes
theme.body: The colours of your profile page.

song.title: Profile song
song.body: A player on your profile, never autoplaying with sound.

roster.title: The VIP online section
roster.body: You show up in the VIP members carousel.

acp.title: VIP Studio
acp.intro: The catalogues VIP members choose from. Any item can be limited to some plans, retired or disabled; members who used it fall back to the defaults.
acp.framePreviewHint: The frame on an avatar at the site's sizes. Change the scale or offset, then save.

hints.name_style: Name styles with their effect and colour variants. No CSS: only colours and effects from the list.
hints.banner: The banners under names: one colour, a gradient (up to 5 colours) or an animation from the list.
hints.frame: Frames are uploaded as PNG, WebP or GIF with transparency, close to square (at least 128 px). GCS re-encodes them to WebP.
hints.card: The images behind the member card (at least 320 px wide). GCS re-encodes them to WebP.
hints.weapon: Weapon icons: transparent PNG or WebP, ideally light lines.
hints.background: Profile backgrounds: an image (also used as the poster) and, optionally, a muted MP4 / WebM video.
hints.theme: Profile page themes: the accent, the second accent and the panel colour.
hints.song: The songs members choose from: an MP3 / Ogg file or a YouTube link.

categories.title: Categories
categories.hint: The filters in the studio. Deleting a category doesn't delete its items.
categories.name: Category name

fields.name: Name
fields.variantsHint: One or more variants; with several, members pick from the colour strip. Colours: 1–5 #RRGGBB codes separated by spaces.
fields.frameFileHint: PNG, WebP or animated GIF with a transparent middle; up to 8 MB.
fields.scaleHint: 100 = the avatar's size; 130 = the frame extends 15% past the avatar on each side.
fields.cardFileHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, ideally 720×400 or larger.
fields.posterHint: Also shown to people who prefer less motion.
fields.videoHint: MP4 or WebM, up to 60 seconds and 40 MB. Plays muted, in a loop.
fields.audioHint: MP3 or Ogg, up to 20 MB.
fields.plansHint: None ticked = available to all VIPs.
fields.retired: Retired (shows marked, but can't be picked)

media.title: Uploaded files
media.usage: Uploaded files: {files}, {mb} MB of the plugin quota in total.

restore.title: Default catalogue
restore.hint: Adds back missing presets or restores all of them to their original form (names, order and data). Items you added stay.

members.title: Member loadouts
members.hint: What members picked. You can remove just the quote or a member's whole loadout (back to defaults).
members.empty: No member has saved a loadout yet.

vipPage.title: Customise your profile
vipPage.body: With a VIP plan you pick your name style ({styles} styles), avatar frame ({frames} frames), banner ({banners}), card background, favourite weapon and profile extras: video background, quote, theme and song.
